g.title: cluster_stats
g.text: Organizer. Single source of truth for stats and modifiers

g.title: SPD
g.text: Particles and FOV from speed multiplier

g.title: GL
g.text: Listens to a GameEvent, calls RequestLazySave

g.title: GRAV
g.text: Gravity each FixedUpdate. Terminal velocity clamp

g.title: MODG->GRAV
g.text: Trigger enter and exit (Collider, tag Player)

g.title: CAM
g.text: Pitch clamped -80 to 80. Yaw used by Movement

g.title: GI
g.text: Start: load or create, then initialize services

g.title: MOVE
g.text: Ground and air movement. Sets velocity

g.title: RUNMOD
g.text: MoveSpeed modifier while run is held

g.title: TSS
g.text: Points per node. Raises talent event
